premises.text: An automated credit-fix process can raise users' scores substantially
premises.evidence_span: automating a system that helps users overcome the challenges that keeps them from their financial goals

premises.text: Unique psychographic, behavioral, and historical credit data creates a holistic view of user motivations and needs
premises.evidence_span: We have a holistic view of our users' motivations, actions, and needs

premises.text: Action-oriented credit engineering beats commoditized free-score and editorial competitors

premises.text: Credit improvement leads users to seek matched financial products via referrals, then the firm's own products
premises.evidence_span: We'll make money by referring them, by matching them to the right financial products, first through referrals, and then by building our own innovative and flexible products that meet their needs
